A '''civil war''' amongst the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] broke out when [[Heta Kol]], along with [[Gender/Legends|her]] faction known as the [[Hidden Chain]] broke away from the other clans and started ambushing Mandalorian naval patrols, culminating in a large-scale [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attack]] on [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'', after which the conflict began escalating into open war. The conflict was the result of the boiling over of the Hidden Chain's members' grievances with Mandalore the Avenger's leadership.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />
